text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging infra on-call @jamal — high p99 latency and streaming stalls observed across us-west-2 GPU pool. Auto-alert: p95 > 800ms, p99 ~ 3.2s on gen-2 streaming route.

jamal: grabbing it. seeing continuous correctable ECC errors on node gpu-az2-17, thermal fan oscillation history. digging logs.

maria: confirming customer-facing page: a few prod keys showing broken streams and client reconnects. Support pinged top 5 customers, they're seeing timeouts in streaming responses.

jamal: quick telemetry snapshot:
```
metric: streaming_latency_p95 = 820ms
metric: streaming_latency_p99 = 3.2s
metric: request_timeouts = +120/min
node: gpu-az2-17 ECC_CE_count delta = +48 in 10m
nvml temp = 86C -> throttle events (SM throttling)
```

jamal: looks like thermal + ECC correctables causing micro stalls and KV cache pressure leads to long tail for streaming clients. gonna mark node for drain and reroute streams.

infra-robin: +1. prepare drain. recommended immediate mitigations: 1) demote node from routing, 2) change routing policy to prefer healthy zone, 3) reduce batch size on streaming router to mitigate queuing.

maria: I've updated the fallback policy to push new requests to model-variant-medium in us-west while we maintain throughput. Customers in EU unaffected.

jamal: running drain now:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-az2-17
kubectl drain node/gpu-az2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

eng-sre-bot: drain started by jamal at 1003004102. Active sessions: 57 streaming sessions will be gracefully migrated. Estimated migration 60-90s.

support-luis: sent updated status to customers: "We are mitigating a GPU node degradation affecting streamed responses in us-west-2. Traffic is routing to healthy nodes; you may see transient reconnects. We'll follow up when resolved."

jamal: noticed NVML log: `nvmlDeviceGetTemperature` spiking and `nvmlDeviceGetEccErrors` reporting correctables on L2 cache. Running quick NV check:
```
nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,THERMAL
# output: Correctable Errors: 0 -> 48 in 10m, Temp=85-87C, Power draw within expected
```

jamal: trying soft driver reset to clear ECC counters on the node (if it doesn't impact running inference). If that fails, we'll reboot host.

infra-robin: prioritize no-coldstart for critical model routes. Use container warm pool in us-west-2 while we evacuate. Also spinning up an extra spare GPU node in the pool.

jamal: soft-reset done, but ECC counter continues to climb and latency not improved. proceeding to full host reboot. ETA 2-3 mins for evacuation and reboot.

maria: during migration, p95 improved slightly to ~560ms but p99 still elevated at ~2.2s due to a small number of long-running sessions hitting fallback paths. Noted increase in consumer reconnects in logs.

support-luis: logging incident impact: approx 4% of requests in us-west-2 saw retry or timeout, 1 customer reported streaming message duplication. Recording for postmortem.

jamal: host reboot complete, node back in cluster but driver reported one correctable ECC event after boot. I'm going to quarantine this GPU (mark as flaky) and replace with spare.

infra-robin: action items executed: 1) quarantined gpu-az2-17 via label `faulty=true` in scheduler, 2) force-scheduled pods to spare node gpu-az2-21, 3) ramped routing back to normal progressively.

jamal: commands used to quarantine and reschedule:
```
kubectl label node gpu-az2-17 maintenance=quarantine
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-az2-17 | xargs -n1 kubectl delete pod --grace-period=30
# autoscaler will bring pods up on spare nodes
```

eng-sre-bot: routing change applied at 1003004330: prefer_zone=us-west-2a -> us-west-2b,c. Circuit-breaker lowered to reduce queuing.

maria: monitoring: p95 now 340ms, p99 620ms, request timeouts back close to baseline. Streaming stall alerts cleared.

jamal: hardware note: vendor RMA ticket created for GPU unit ID 4 on server gpu-az2-17. ECC correctables + persistent thermal oscillation flagged.

maria: customer comms updated; sent follow-up with root-cause summary and immediate mitigations. Asked support to offer extended logs and credits where customers experienced >2% error rate.

support-luis: added incident tag `impact:partial` and recorded affected customer IDs.

selene: taking over on-call for next shift. jamal, any outstanding handover notes?

jamal: handover notes: node quarantined and removed from rotation, spare capacity provisioned, vendor RMA opened (ticket #RMA-7832), follow-up validation scheduled after replacement, postmortem owner: jamal. Key metrics saved in incident dashboard.

selene: acknowledged, I'll monitor until hardware replaced. If we see recurrence, we'll trigger cross-zone fallback and extended throttling controls.

maria: post-incident checklist:
- author postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps
- add automated thermal threshold to trigger proactive cordon at 80C
- investigate VM power profile causing oscillation
- run unit of stress test on replacement hardware before reintroducing into pool

jamal: thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups and will start postmortem doc.

eng-sre-bot: incident resolved at 1003004708. Final status: partial impact, routing mitigations applied, faulty GPU quarantined, RMA initiated.

selene: handing off to infra rotation for long-term monitoring.

maria: closing thread and linking to postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
